name: Mahou Shoujo Western Girls
original_name: 魔法少女ウェスタンガールズ
source:
In a world that is very near and far at the same time from where we live.
This is a story about battles between pure magical girls of justice and monsters of evil organization in such world.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184574.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在一个离我们居住的地方既近又远的世界里。
这是一个关于正义的纯洁魔法少女与邪恶组织的怪物在这样的世界中展开战斗的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184574.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
